title: Wiemer contact form (v2)
description: A contact page's opening band on grey: a centred accent tag, a mid-size heading and one line of text, then a narrow off-white form card with name, email, message, consent and a full-width accent button, floating over a field of big pale perforation dots.
notes: made to sit under wiemer-v2-header (solid variant)
the dots show from lg up; phones get the heading and the card
posts to `action`; wire validation and sending in your app
